name: zerobleed
description: ZeroBleed: a need-to-know context broker for agentic audits, built on Zetaris, Meterless Nightshift and the Markovian engine.

scripts.test: SAMPLE_MODE=true DATA_PORT=8798 node --import tsx --test tests/*.test.ts && npm run -s conformance
scripts.publish:site: git subtree split --prefix site -b gh-pages-tmp && git push -f origin gh-pages-tmp:gh-pages && git branch -D gh-pages-tmp
scripts.bench:setup: tsx scripts/setupZetaris.ts procurement-bench && tsx scripts/setupZetaris.ts incident-bench
